items.title: OpenAI Cancels Latest Model Release Ahead of DevDay Conference: Report
items.summary: On the eve of its developer conference, OpenAI scrapped the release of its most advanced artificial intelligence model due to safety concerns.  According to a report from The Wall Street Journal, OpenAI isn’t moving ahead with the release of its GPT-6.1 Astra, which was initially slated to be announced in the coming days or weeks with a potential October debut.  Conversations surrounding the threats AI could pose to society have garnered a lot of attention following news that OpenAI’s models took “dangerous actions that no human directed,” to breach the systems of Hugging Face, another AI company.

items.title: Why Meta (META) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of social network operator Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) fell 4.1% in the morning session as investors locked in profits following a 13% weekly rally driven by its new Muse artificial intelligence agent, while borrowing plans added pressure.
